hero.title: A short mapping that translates an organizational challenge into the human capability worth developing.
hero.body: Six questions help us identify your organization's current leverage point. Every organization faces different challenges, and the purpose here is to sharpen where it makes sense to begin.
hero.subtitle: A 3-minute organizational needs assessment

panel.title: The central challenge is often not a lack of professional knowledge, but people's ability to remain effective when conditions change.
panel.body: That may appear in decision-making, communication, workload, or managers' ability to create clarity.

controls.selectionLimit: You can choose up to {{max}} options for this question.
controls.selectionConflict: These options cannot be selected together because they conflict.
controls.answersCleared: Later selections that no longer matched your updated answer were cleared.

journey.title: This is what the mapping journey looks like.
journey.body: The questionnaire is presented here as a focused content page to create an experience that feels serious, professional, and clear.

challenge.question: What is the main challenge you are dealing with right now?
challenge.helper: Difficulty maintaining stability, flexibility, and effective functioning in changing conditions.

impact.question: Where do you see the impact of this challenge?

options.decisionMaking: In the quality and speed of decision-making
options.loadAndChange: In coping with workload and change
options.unclearImpact: It is still difficult for us to define the impact

desiredChange.question: What would you want to see happening differently?
desiredChange.helper: If the process succeeds, what would be different in three to six months?

options.confidentEmployees: Employees acting with more confidence and independence
options.adaptableTeams: Teams adapting more effectively to change
options.loadResilience: A stronger ability to handle workload and uncertainty

audience.question: Who needs this change the most?

options.changeGroup: A group currently going through change
options.unclear: It is not yet fully clear

options.knowProblemAndGoal: We know the problem and what we want to achieve
options.needToRefineNeed: We can see the challenge, but we still need to sharpen the need
options.solutionUnclear: We know something needs to change, but the solution is not yet clear
options.needMapping: We first want to map and understand the need

tomorrowProblem.question: If you could solve one thing for your people by tomorrow, what would you choose?
tomorrowProblem.helper: There is no need to phrase it formally. Write it the way you would say it in conversation.
tomorrowProblem.prompt: An open question for a free-text response
